     7 | //! Astrid Kernel - The core execution engine and IPC router.
     8 | //!
     9 | //! The Kernel is a pure, decentralized WASM runner. It contains no business
    10 | //! logic, no cognitive loops, and no network servers. Its sole responsibility
    11 | //! is to instantiate `astrid_events::EventBus`, load `.capsule` files into
    12 | //! the Component Model WASM sandbox, expose native socket management, and route
    13 | //! IPC bytes between them.

    51 |     pub overlay_vfs: Arc<OverlayVfs>,
    52 |     /// Ephemeral upper directory for the overlay VFS. Kept alive for the
    53 |     /// kernel session lifetime; dropped on shutdown to discard uncommitted writes.
    54 |     _upper_dir: Arc<tempfile::TempDir>,
    55 |     /// The global physical root handle (cap-std) for the VFS.
    56 |     pub vfs_root_handle: DirHandle,
    57 |     /// The physical path the VFS is mounted to.

    63 |     ///
